verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence of a user-defined rule feature is a single reference to 'Stripe Billing automations' that control customer communications. Webhooks only push events to your own endpoint, which makes them a developer building block. Smart Retries is fixed automatic behavior rather than user-defined rules, so neither earns credit. missing for 10: documentation of how automation rules are defined (triggers, conditions, actions), the range of events and actions supported, any agent- or API-driven rule authoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Automate many of your customer interactions by combining a customer portal with customer communications controlled by Stripe Billing automations.
